raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Planner initiated a repetitive loop by reissuing nearly identical instructions to verify “exact decision dates” despite already having sufficient information (Selle v. Gibb in 1984; Reynolds v. Sims in 1964) to conclude that Reynolds v. Sims was decided first. This failure to consolidate available results and finalize an answer led to circular, redundant actions and stalled progress.
